title: Humility
definition: Humility is the Spirit-formed posture of lowliness before God and others, free from pride and self-exaltation.
summary: Christlike disciples walk in humility because they know all grace comes from God.
christFocus: Jesus Christ humbled Himself to serve and save, becoming the supreme pattern of humility.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Humility describes a Spirit-formed pattern of life for those who belong to Jesus Christ. Christian living is not an attempt to earn salvation but the grateful response of people who have been saved by grace and called to walk with the Lord.

Scripture presents this truth so believers can grow in holiness, endurance, love, wisdom, worship, and mission. It touches the heart, the mind, the tongue, relationships, daily habits, and faithful obedience in ordinary life.

The emphasis of this doctrine is christlike disciples walk in humility because they know all grace comes from god.. It points disciples away from self-reliance and toward abiding dependence on Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because discipleship can become shallow when it is reduced to information, emotion, or outward activity alone. Humility teaches believers how grace becomes visible in daily conduct, perseverance, relationships, and obedience to Christ.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Ask the Lord to form this truth in you through Scripture, prayer, repentance, and faithful practice. Let humility shape how you think, speak, serve, endure, forgive, and represent Christ in the places God has assigned to you.
